notes: Names created on the cloud side that Windows cannot create through the normal API; the mount and the mirror have to bring them to the user. seed-download.ps1 seeds this layout on the provider side of a hermetic localfs profile.
text files end with their own relative path unless plain is true; no file is larger than 1,000 bytes.
The case-only twin pair is deliberate: a volume that folds case keeps only the first of the two, and the seeder says so instead of failing. On a real cloud both exist.

files.name: trailing-dot.txt.
files.text: a trailing dot, legal in the cloud, refused by the normal Windows API

files.name: trailing-space.txt
files.text: a trailing space, legal in the cloud, refused by the normal Windows API

files.name: CON
files.text: a reserved device name without an extension

files.name: PRN.txt
files.text: a reserved device name with an extension

files.name: NUL.csv
files.text: another reserved device name, in a folder that also holds ordinary files

files.name: report.txt
files.text: the lower-case half of a case-only twin pair

files.name: REPORT.TXT
files.text: the upper-case half of a case-only twin pair
